test_data.description: IN_PROGRESS group order session with social_group_details attached, source MANUAL

test_data_output.identification_notes: handle_group_order_create + handle_group_order_join would cover the base 'session in progress with 3 participants' state (same as FIX-GOFOODSG-005), but no operation in the catalog exposes a field to attach a social group (source=MANUAL) to the session -- operationInput contracts for handle_group_order_create/join carry no social-group parameter. Per the all-or-nothing rule the whole fixture is unsupported. ALREADY_SATISFIED restaurant half: GroupOrderConstants.GO_RESTO_1 is a group-order-enabled resto with max_participants 8 (assertCreateGroupOrder). Social-group attachment (source=MANUAL) remains TDP_NOT_SUPPORTED — no catalog op attaches a social group.

test_data.description: Host customer with a GoPay account who is the ACTIVE OWNER of a GOTO social group with 3 ACTIVE members

test_data_output.identification_notes: get_supported_category proposed CUSTOMER_WITH_SUBSCRIPTION -- rejected, 'SUBSCRIPTION' not corroborated by any signal (top candidates: CUSTOMER_WITH_GO_PAY, VANILLA, CUSTOMER_WITH_GOCORP, ...). The GoPay-account portion alone would be covered by CUSTOMER_WITH_GO_PAY, but no operation exists in the TestBuddy/Pertamax catalog to create a social group, make this customer its owner, or add active members, so the fixture as a whole is unsupported.

test_data.description: Two customers with GoPay accounts who are session participants but not members of the social group

tdp_request.description: Two customers with GoPay accounts who are session participants but not members of the social group

test_data_output.identification_notes: CUSTOMER_WITH_GO_PAY corroborated by 'GoPay'. Session participation is established later at the BOOKING fixture (FIX-GOFOODSG-005/007) via handle_group_order_join, not a customer-level operation. 'Not a social group member' is the default absence of state.
